# kion_funding_source_enforcement (Resource)

Manages a Kion Funding Source Enforcement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_funding_source_enforcement" "example" {
  # Required
  funding_source_id = 1
  threshold         = 1
  timeframe         = "example"

  # Optional
  # cloud_rule_id  = 1
  # description    = "example"
  # enabled        = false
  # overburn       = false
  # spend_option   = "example"
  # user_group_ids = []
  # user_ids       = []
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `funding_source_id` (Number) The ID of the funding source the enforcement belongs to.
- `threshold` (Number) Threshold value in dollars.
- `timeframe` (String) Timeframe of the enforcement.
Valid values are "lifetime", "month", "year"

### Optional

- `cloud_rule_id` (Number) Optional ID of cloud rule that is attached to the enforcement.
Use endpoint /v3/cloud-rule to get a list of valid cloud rules and IDs.
- `description` (String) Optional, user-provided description of the enforcement.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the enforcement is enabled.
- `overburn` (Boolean) Flag that specifies if enforcement will place project in a overburn state when triggered. Options are: true, false.
- `spend_option` (String) Type of spend option.
Valid values are "spend", "remaining".
- `user_group_ids` (Set of Number) List of user group IDs that will receive notifications from the enforcement. Is required if no user IDs are listed.
- `user_ids` (Set of Number) List of user IDs that will receive notifications from the enforcement. Is required if no user group IDs are listed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Funding source ID.
- `triggered` (Boolean) Whether the enforcement has been triggered.
